verdict.rationale: Cake shows 'fast board sign-offs and e-signing in minutes with automated flows' for stock option approvals, implying board consent routing via e-signature, but there's no evidence of drafting stockholder approval documents beyond options, no mention of archiving signed consents against specific transactions, and no dedicated board-consent/governance module documented. missing for 10: evidence of stockholder approval drafting (not just board sign-off for options), archival/linking of executed consents to the specific transaction record, template library for consent types, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the e-sign workflow.
